detailed_description: WiFi QR Code Generator creates a standard WiFi QR payload and a scannable PNG preview from a network name, password, encryption type, and hidden-network setting. It supports WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP, and no-password networks, escapes special characters in SSIDs and passwords, and keeps the generated QR image local in your browser.
usage_steps: Enter the SSID exactly as it appears on the router or access point.
Choose WPA/WPA2/WPA3, WEP, or no-password mode and add the password when required.
Set the hidden-network option if the SSID is not broadcast.
Copy the WiFi payload or download the generated QR Code PNG.
usage_examples: Create a guest WiFi QR code for a reception desk, cafe counter, or meeting room.
Generate a copy-ready WIFI:T:WPA payload for testing QR scanner behavior.
Download a PNG QR code before printing a small sign for visitors.

faqs.question: Is WiFi QR Code Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool is free to use in your browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The WiFi payload and QR image are generated locally in your browser.

faqs.question: Will the QR code work on phones?
faqs.answer: Most modern iOS and Android camera apps can scan standard WiFi QR codes and offer to join the network.

faqs.question: What WiFi QR format does it generate?
faqs.answer: It generates the standard WIFI:T:<encryption>;S:<ssid>;P:<password>;H:<hidden>;; payload used by common mobile camera apps.
